clusters.headline: President Ruto And Former Deputy Gachagua Exchange Sharp Criticisms
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto has publicly labeled former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua a chief extortionist.
Ruto compared Gachagua to King Herod, alleging the former official targets rising political leaders.

clusters.headline: Armed Ambush On Road Construction Team Kills Seven In Mandera County
aiSummaryBullets: Seven individuals were killed during an armed attack in Mandera County.
The victims included five civilian construction workers and two National Police Reservists.

clusters.headline: Former Football Kenya Federation Official Challenges Removal By Fifa
aiSummaryBullets: MacDonald Mariga has submitted documentation to Fifa to contest his removal from the Football Kenya Federation vice presidency.
The ouster occurred during a tumultuous special general meeting in Meru that involved police intervention and the removal of several NEC members.

clusters.headline: High Court Orders Investigation Into Abduction Of Lawyer Abshir Abdi
aiSummaryBullets: The High Court determined that police must answer for the whereabouts of the missing lawyer.
Judge Alexander Muteti stated that security agency denials are insufficient to close the matter.

clusters.headline: Kenya Moves To Improve Road Safety And Join Global Climate Accord
aiSummaryBullets: The Kenya Bureau of Standards is implementing international road safety protocols to decrease traffic-related fatalities.
National authorities aim to create a unified strategy for transport safety and institutional accountability.

clusters.headline: President Ruto Launches Four-Day Development Tour In Gusii Region
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto initiated a four-day development tour across Nyamira and Kisii counties.
The official visit includes the commissioning of various government projects and engagement with local residents.

clusters.headline: Karauri joins UDA to challenge Sakaja for Nairobi governor seat
aiSummaryBullets: Capital FM reports: Karauri joins UDA to challenge Sakaja for Nairobi governor seat
Nation Africa reports: Kasarani MP Ronald Karauri joins UDA, eyes Nairobi governor seat

clusters.headline: President Ruto Nominates New Data Commissioner And State CEOs
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto has nominated Lydia Sitienei Chelagat to serve as the new Data Commissioner.
The nomination has been submitted to the Kenyan Parliament for formal review and consideration.

clusters.headline: Teachers Service Commission Announces Over Seven Thousand Vacancies
aiSummaryBullets: The Teachers Service Commission is recruiting for 7,720 permanent teaching positions.
The openings are distributed across primary schools, junior schools, and secondary education institutions.

clusters.headline: Kenyan Cult Leader Receives 200 Year Sentence For Shakahola Deaths
aiSummaryBullets: Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years in prison for his role in the deaths of 191 individuals.
The judicial decision follows a conviction on 191 counts of murder issued by the court on October 19, 2026.
